visual_findings: The imported body remains too dark and low-contrast in hero, macro, gameplay, and comparison views. Navy, black, gunmetal, ribs, latches, and the outer ring collapse into one near-black mass instead of reproducing the approved Blender hierarchy.

The evidence does not present the signature +Z center-plus-six deep-well face in a readable front three-quarter, front macro, or gameplay shot. The dominant approved identity is therefore absent from the Unity gate; current side/rear framing cannot prove correct flight orientation.

Muzzle is a tiny white core with one narrow orange cone, uniform round glow, and a few straight white bars. It is materially smaller and simpler than the Gunner_Bullet/Fighter_Attack comparison and does not read as a heavy seven-chamber discharge.

Attached Flight is reduced to three small tapered lobes plus white needle bars. It lacks a compact layered pressure wake, body-contact glow, velocity mass, and gameplay readability; rear and side views make it look pasted to one end.

Impact is still a tiny core with two broken circular arc fragments and sparse needle rays. Contact and peak are almost the same scale and composition, while decay becomes a faint patterned card. It does not read as a broad multi-chamber scrap-metal impact.
The suite remains below the user commercial body floor, the supplied school projectile/VFX references, and the Gunner_Bullet/Fighter_Attack comparison despite a clean technical audit.

r6_authorization.first_prove_plus_z_front_orientation: Add fixed-rig +Z front orthographic, +Z front three-quarter, and +Z well macro captures. If the seven wells are not the true +Z flight face, correct only the derived prefab/model-child orientation and revalidate bounds/hierarchy; never mutate the FBX source.
r6_authorization.body_material_requirement: Recalibrate the six external URP/Lit materials from the approved Blender runtime hero so dark blue, black, brushed silver, gunmetal and brass remain distinctly readable without whitewash.
r6_authorization.muzzle_requirement: Build a larger compact asymmetric seven-port pressure discharge with layered soft core, short unequal exhaust wedges and restrained sparks; no uniform halo, full ring, white bars, or opaque cards.
r6_authorization.flight_requirement: Create a continuous rear-contact layered wake with 5-7 unequal chamber pulses or scalloped lobes tied to the body, plus restrained scrap-hot particles; no three cloned cones or needle bars.
r6_authorization.impact_requirement: Create a materially broader asymmetric seven-chamber shock with broken pressure lobes, hot fragments, soot and readable decay; no circular arc fragments as the main identity, no line-star, no patterned residue card.

root_note: R5 is technically clean but visually rejected. Preserve it as before evidence. Root approval requires the seven-well face to read in Unity at the true flight front and all three VFX phases to meet the supplied commercial minimum without cards, rings, needles, or dark collapse.
